verdict: PASS WITH MODERATE REPAIRS: no critical or major mathematical blocker; ready for manuscript drafting, but not yet submission-grade as a reproducibility bundle.

findings.title: No committed environment lock or portable bootstrap
evidence: research/experiments/TARGET_A_REPRODUCTION.md:8-10 records versions but obtains NumPy from a host-specific path.
research/experiments/TARGET_A_REPRODUCTION.md:82-109 gives absolute-path reproduction commands.
research/paper/TARGET_A_FINITE_COMPUTATION_TRUST_MODEL.md:52-59 says the supplement should include a machine-readable environment lock and command manifest.
Clean-tree pytest collection failed because NumPy was absent; installing the recorded numpy==2.3.5 into the temporary review directory made all tests pass.
findings.consequence: A referee cannot run the advertised suite from a fresh checkout without reconstructing an undocumented host-specific dependency path.
findings.required_action: Commit a portable machine-readable environment lock/bootstrap, replace absolute-path commands, and verify default and slow lanes in a clean environment created only from the lock.

findings.title: Human radical comparison omits the r>4 branch premise
evidence: research/proofs/TARGET_A_LOW_PERIOD_SPECTRAL_FRONTIER.md:179-197 claims u>0 and u^2>5 imply r>eta without stating r>4.
research/scripts/verify_target_a_low_period_spectral_frontier.py:171-177 correctly rejects value<=4 before applying the squared comparison.
findings.consequence: The certificates remain valid, but the standalone human proof has a genuine logical omission that could propagate into the manuscript.
findings.required_action: State and prove r>4 before squaring, include it in the displayed certificate conditions, and add a low-branch negative regression.

findings.title: Low-period checker counts rows but does not bind them to the full canonical orbit set
evidence: research/scripts/verify_target_a_low_period_spectral_frontier.py:238-246 checks independent counts and unique orbit IDs.
research/scripts/verify_target_a_low_period_spectral_frontier.py:250-262 checks each supplied row individually but not equality with an independently enumerated representative set.
Reviewer Zero independently compared the full canonical sets and found no missing, extra, or duplicate row in the committed artifact.
findings.consequence: The table is complete in fact, but the checker could accept an omitted orbit replaced by a duplicate canonical word under a new unique ID and valid duplicate certificate.
findings.required_action: Compare the stored (p,Q) set exactly with an independent canonical enumeration, bind orbit IDs to deterministic order, and add omission/duplicate tamper tests.

findings.title: The canonical minimality checker does not replay per-state mathematics for n<=22
evidence: research/scripts/verify_target_a_minimality_certificate.py:98-118 validates aggregate historical records for n<=20.
research/scripts/verify_target_a_minimality_certificate.py:121-150 validates aggregate shell/certificate records for n=22.
research/paper/TARGET_A_FINITE_COMPUTATION_TRUST_MODEL.md:20-42 correctly discloses the integrity-versus-regeneration boundary.
Reviewer Zero reran exact n=8,10,...,22 computations successfully with zero fallbacks and zero counterexamples.
findings.consequence: No mismatch was observed, but the committed one-command checker is partly an attestation/hash check rather than a full mathematical replay over C3's complete range.
findings.required_action: Retain the computer-assisted label; for submission add a clean-HEAD full-range regeneration manifest or independently replayable per-state certificates for n<=22.

findings.title: Canonical package snapshots do not identify the reviewed HEAD
evidence: research/paper/target_a_claim_inventory.json:4-5 names frozen commit/tree dfb9c984.../7a15c449....
research/reproducibility/target_a_full_slow_reproduction_summary.json:6-11 names baseline c5cadf3e.../dc08b21b....
research/scripts/verify_target_a_paper_package.py:62-67 hard-codes the older claim-inventory identifiers rather than reviewed HEAD b9e00bd3....
findings.consequence: Artifact hashes pass, but canonical metadata does not mechanically identify the reviewed final commit as the theorem snapshot.
findings.required_action: Publish a final manifest naming the drafting/submission HEAD and tree, or an explicit immutable mapping proving that no claim-bearing artifact changed.

findings.title: Production generator independence above n=24 is aggregate rather than recordwise
evidence: research/audit/DIRECT_BRACELET_GENERATOR_AUDIT.md:27-46 establishes ordered record equality only through n=22.
research/paper/TARGET_A_FINITE_COMPUTATION_TRUST_MODEL.md:44-50 says dual-generator recordwise agreement extends through n=24.
research/scripts/target_a_direct_generator_audit.py:155-164 checks only aggregate Burnside totals, represented-size sums, order, and parity at production scale.
Reviewer Zero reran the n=26,28,30 slow audits successfully.
findings.consequence: No discrepancy was observed, but a largest-order representative/orbit-size defect preserving all aggregates lies outside the independent audit.
findings.required_action: Provide a proof-oriented validation of the FKM/reflection/orbit-size implementation for arbitrary n or a separately implemented partitioned recordwise validation for n=26,28,30.

high_risk_checklist.item: Claim scopes exclude all-period/all-signings/global-finite-n overclaims and restrict the infinite family to multiples of eight.
The n=32 witness has exact positive-definiteness, exact threshold comparison, and independent gauge reconstruction.
Finite and infinite Floquet decompositions, both holonomies, and the z^L=alpha boundary are explicit and verified.
The period-8 determinant, uniform positivity, sharp constant, and unique z=1 edge have independent exact routes.
Moment implications are one-way only and short-cell collision multiplicities are retained.
Period-8 classification covers all 128 legal flux words and distinguishes exact signatures from numeric coincidences.
Translation/reflection/negation and repeated-cell zone folding are proved, including odd-cell z -> -z and the doubled p=16 target.
The committed 2626-row low-period table is complete, but independent checker set-binding needs repair.
Finite minimality regeneration and generator audits are successful but not uniform in trust level across all orders.
Reproduction versions are recorded, but a portable environment lock and final-HEAD provenance manifest are missing.
